"贪污" is also a crime for public officials who embezzle public funds. The facts list both: first part labeled (1)职务侵占, second part (二)贪污. So the charges are "职务侵占" and "贪污". Possibly also "挪用特定款物"? No, not here. So answer: [罪名]职务侵占;贪污<eoa>
